demo.description: Original fictional scenarios created for this prototype with AI assistance.
demo.timestamps: Generated at runtime, one minute apart from the saved demo anchor. They are simulation times, not historical publication dates.

liveSources.name: Google News RSS
liveSources.use: Default news source; public headline text, source URL and publication time.
liveSources.coverage: Selected index companies and financial terms in the last day.
liveSources.access: No API key required. Upstream provider terms apply.

liveSources.name: Hacker News via Algolia
liveSources.use: Public community-submitted story titles, post URLs and timestamps.
liveSources.coverage: NVIDIA-related stories in the last day.
liveSources.access: No API key required. Upstream provider terms apply.

liveSources.name: GDELT
liveSources.use: Optional news adapter enabled with NEWS_SOURCE=gdelt.
liveSources.coverage: English headlines mentioning selected index companies in the last day.
liveSources.timestamps: Uses GDELT observation time, not a separate publication timestamp.
liveSources.access: No API key required. Upstream provider terms apply.

model.name: Xenova/finbert
model.use: Pretrained sentiment inference. No model training is performed in this project.
model.distribution: Weights download at runtime and retain their upstream license.
